question: Three Poets Pampa, Ponna and Ranna are called as the 'Three Jewels' of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kannada Literature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pampa, Ponna, and Ranna are renowned as the ‘Three Jewels’ (Ratnatraya) of **Kannada literature**.
 
• These poets made significant contributions during the period of Kannada classical literature which is also known as the Old Kannada period.
 
• Pampa is celebrated for his epic works like ‘Adi Purana’ and ‘Vikramarjuna Vijaya’.
 
• Ranna is known for his famous work ‘Sahasa Bhima Vijaya’ or ‘Gadayuddha’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pampa**

 
 
• Pampa, also known as Adikavi, is one of the earliest poets of Kannada literature.
 
• His significant works include ‘Adi Purana’, which narrates the story of the first Jain Tirthankara Rishabhadeva, and ‘Vikramarjuna Vijaya’, which is a Jain version of the Mahabharata.
 
 
 
• **Ponna**
 
 
• Ponna was another celebrated Kannada poet and a contemporary of Pampa.
 
• He is known for his work ‘Shanti Purana’ which is a Jain epic that narrates the life of Shantinatha, the 16th Tirthankara.
 
 
 
• **Ranna**
 
 
• Ranna is considered one of the greatest Kannada poets.
 
• His notable work ‘Gadayuddha’ (The Battle of Clubs) is a retelling of the Mahabharata focusing on the duel between Bhima and Duryodhana.
 
 
 
• **Kannada Literature**
 
 
• Kannada literature has a rich heritage dating back over a thousand years.
 
• It includes a wide range of texts in poetry, prose, and drama, and is known for its classical and medieval works.
 
• The period of the ‘Three Jewels’ is particularly significant in the history of Kannada literature, often regarded as its golden age.
